playwright.description: Stage 1: Official Microsoft Playwright Accessibility-Tree MCP connected to Captain's Edge CDP (port 9222)

windows.description: Stage 2: CursorTouch/Windows-MCP native Windows 11 OS UI Automation server (set enabled: true after installing uvx)

composio.description: Stage 3: Composio MCP server (handled directly via ComposioAppBridge in composio_bridge.py; reads COMPOSIO_API_KEY from .env)

filesystem.description: Official MCP Filesystem server (set enabled: true and customize your allowed folder path)
